title: Hành lý của tôi ở trong cốp xe.
englishTitle: My luggage is in the trunk.
pronunciation: Hanh ly cua toi o trong cop xe
summary: For telling a driver or staff member that your luggage is still in the trunk.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: The car has not left yet, or the driver is about to move on.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Point to the vehicle or trunk while you say it. Keep the ride screen visible if you need the driver identified.

phrases.vietnamese: Hành lý của tôi ở trong cốp xe.
phrases.english: My luggage is in the trunk.
phrases.pronunciation: Hanh ly cua toi o trong cop xe

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Hành lý của tôi means my luggage; ở trong cốp xe means is in the trunk.

breakdown.vietnamese: Hành lý của tôi ở trong cốp xe.
breakdown.english: My luggage is in the trunk.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Open the trunk, put my bag here, and left something in the car phrases cover nearby luggage moments.

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi có thể đặt túi của tôi ở đây được không?
phrases.english: Can I put my bag here?
phrases.pronunciation: Toi co the dat tui cua toi o day duoc khong

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi để quên thứ gì đó trong xe
phrases.english: I left something in the car
phrases.pronunciation: Toi de quen thu gi do trong xe

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good after taxis, Grab rides, hotel transfers, buses, airport pickups, and any ride where bags were loaded for you.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Act quickly but calmly. The car, plate, driver, or company is the detail that helps most.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Call the driver, contact the company, driver left, different car number, and stop near the entrance phrases cover recovery.

phrases.vietnamese: Bạn có thể giúp tôi liên hệ với công ty được không?

phrases.vietnamese: Người lái xe rời đi mà không có tôi

phrases.vietnamese: Vui lòng dừng gần lối vào
phrases.pronunciation: Vui long dung gan loi vao
